FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At The Groom Room, we specialize in providing high-quality services in a dedicated commercial space. Our licensed and certified staff offer an array of services, including haircuts, styling, coloring, shaving, conditioning, and shampooing, ensuring compliance with local regulations and industry standards. We maintain robust sanitation protocols and utilize only professional-grade products and equipment to minimize risk and enhance the client experience. Our operations are designed for efficiency, featuring a digital appointment management system that streamlines client bookings and reduces scheduling errors. With a focus on customer satisfaction and safety, we are committed to fostering a welcoming environment for all our clients.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on July 12, 2023, due to water damage from a leaking roof causing cosmetic damage to salon furniture and flooring. The estimated amount of loss is $1,200. The claim is currently in progress, and we are awaiting coverage confirmation from our insurance provider.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system and secure perimeter fencing around the premises.
